briefings.title: Marc Benioff on the AI boom, SaaSpocalypse, and future of Slack
briefings.tldr: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff discusses the AI boom, framing San Francisco's resurgence through historic gold rushes, and detailing Salesforce's deep investments in AI agents, Slack as an operating system, and the Anthropic partnership.

briefings.title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026
briefings.tldr: Marc Benioff and Sam Altman discuss the rapid advancement of generative AI at Dreamforce 2026, highlighting the emergence of powerful autonomous models, enterprise agentic workflows, and the critical need for industry-wide safety, alignment, and robust cyber defense.

briefings.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Joins Marc Benioff as AI Debate Takes Center Stage at Dreamforce | AI1G
briefings.tldr: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff discussed the transition of enterprises into "agentic AI companies" at Dreamforce 2026, emphasizing that AI serves as a new technological layer that drives productivity and transforms every industry rather than destroying jobs.

briefings.title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
briefings.tldr: Salesforce reported a strong Q1 with 14% year-over-year revenue growth to $11 billion and massive EPS growth, driven by its aggressive $27 billion buyback strategy and the rapid enterprise adoption of its AI-powered Agentforce platform.

briefings.title: Trump-Xi Summit, Benioff: "Not My First SaaSpocalypse," OpenAI vs Apple, Multi-Sensory AI, El Niño
briefings.tldr: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff and the "Besties" analyze the Trump-Xi summit's focus on economic entanglement as a deterrent to war, while addressing the "SaaSpocalypse" market rerating and the shift toward multi-sensory, agentic AI models.
